title: A universal model for the bifurcations of asymptotic values
summary: We study the notion of tangent-like maps, which is a transcendental analogue of polynomial-like maps. We introduce a model family analogous to quadratic polynomials, with only one free asymptotic value, and define the "Tandelbrot set" as the analogue of the Mandelbrot set. We prove a Straightening Theorem for tangent-like maps, with uniqueness of the model map in the case where the filled-in Julia set is connected, and a parameter version of the Straightening Theorem for suitable holomorphic families of tangent-like maps.
